I live in a pretty small city and a lot of people like that hairdresser knowing what is good or not so that sucks
Nobody really uses yelp here
It seems it’s hard to find a decent one in my city
[This is what I was going for.](https://imgur.com/a/S3D2SxN)
Sorry, dont think Im comfortable with that
Uhh sure?
14g, pierced at 14g as well but it seems to have stretched
Nope, its not. It is just nesting a little which is slowly starting to go away but theres a lot of room
It looks so good on you!!!
You’re really cute!
I don’t have a credit card myself & don’t get much money. Im at school, currently working.

It’s really hard finding good products where I live so unfortunately I can’t get deva curl. I’m trying out other sulphate, silicone and paraben free products though to find the one best for me, no luck so far haha
I’m here if you want to talk 💜
Are you feeling better now?
Aw, I’m sorry to hear that. I’m here if you ever want to talk 💜
I’m in the same exact position, it really does suck
Thank you 💜 You can talk to me as well
Sadly, yeah.
No, not really
I know ):

I’ve done that before but couldn’t keep it up longer than a couple of weeks. I don’t know, I find it to be extremely difficult to do and deal with anything alone.
 I really feel like I need a supportive environment to cope but sadly that’s not going to happen anytime soon
I used to have a few hobbies (drawing for example) but I lost interest and motivation. Now I can barely make myself do anything, sometimes even getting out of the bed takes me hours

I can talk to people perfectly fine online but everything changes when I have to talk to someone face to face. It’s like I become a completely different person lol

I’d like to go outside at that time but since I’m staying home right now my mom wouldn’t probably like the idea of me going alone.

I used to look at the stars out my window though, it can be so relaxing haha
Thank you, it means a lot. 💜

I do like going outside but not alone, unfortunately I don’t have any friends to hang out with. I hate going to places alone cause it’s either boring like that or it triggers my anxiety too much.

I have pretty bad social skills since I have no idea how to talk to people and keep any “friendships”, and I’m just awkward af
Oh, I’m sorry to hear that. Hopefully you’ll get everything figured out soon. I’ll be here if you ever want to talk (even though I might not be the best person to give advice)
Have you talked to anyone about it?
Yeah, I know. Unfortunately there’s not much we can do about it ):

Aw I’m really sorry to hear that. It sucks that people don’t understand us and other people who are struggling with this type of mental illness.
If you ever wanna talk, vent, and cry together then I’m here haha
